scanWindow: Catch-up scan from 2026-10-10 (the day after the newest feed item dated 2026-10-09) through 2026-10-12 03:19 SAST. Catch-up was triggered because the newest feed item is more than 72 hours old; the prior successful publication was dated 2026-10-11.

github-copilot-jetbrains-model-mcp-contr.reason: GitHub's canonical changelog confirms enterprise-managed defaults for available Copilot agent models, an option to disable automatic MCP server startup, a diagnostic Fix action and JetBrains IDE 2025.2+ support. The model and MCP controls create a practical workflow and governance change for JetBrains teams; the improvements are more than UI polish, though limited to this IDE plugin.

nvidia-reflection-ai-investment-talks.reason: Reuters reported that the Financial Times said NVIDIA was in talks to invest further in or acquire Reflection AI. This is an unconfirmed report about possible talks, not a completed or announced transaction; neither company supplied primary confirmation, so it does not meet the verification rule.

amazon-decart-acquisition-talks.reason: Reuters reported that the Wall Street Journal said Amazon was in talks to buy AI startup Decart. No acquisition was announced or confirmed by Amazon or Decart; reporting about negotiations alone is not sufficient to publish a completed ecosystem shift.

The policy question could matter, but the reported reversal is not sufficiently verified.
